scope: complete real paragraph CLI read raw and healed, plus separately profiled identical worker entrypoints

domains: Python3.12 CLI: source loading, subprocess transport/wait, event validation/assembly, whole and paragraph profiles, JSON serialization
Python3.14 GSE worker: resource receipts, raw/healed policy, lexical words, utterance encoding, claim extraction/derivation, whole-document resolution/graph/fold, event serialization
caveats: The parent cProfile cannot attribute GSE subprocess internals; the worker cProfile is a separate fresh process with the same frozen payload, not a nested full CLI capture.
Independent parent/worker timings cannot be added or subtracted; instrumentation overhead differs.
Native extension time is attributed to Python call boundaries, not native function internals.
macOS time counters are OS-reported process/rusage observations, not per-function memory attribution or concurrent process-tree peak memory.
One cold-process observation per mode/domain; OS caches and concurrent machine activity were not controlled.
The first sandboxed time -l capture failed reading kern.clockrate; its incomplete resource receipt is excluded.

source.profiled_role: draft.txt fixture label, not an authored revision

resource_independent_count_baselines.scope: located source population and public path/catalog operations, independent of elapsed time or hardware counters; symbolic/lexical result counts remain bound to recorded resource identities

comparison.domain_cli: entire emitted JSON record against saved final CLI output in the same raw/healed mode
comparison.domain_worker: complete assembled Reading against saved final CLI Reading; same frozen adapter adds consumer identity
comparison.normalization: remove only cache on recognized gse.healing-resources/1 file receipts and mirrored resources.wordnet.resource; no code/state/path/hash/semantic/timing exclusions

payload.raw: true for raw, false for healed

commands.exact_resolved_commands: preserved privately in runs.private.json; command parameters contain no source prose
